This '''individual''' worked as a [[Musician/Legends|musician]] in [[Jokko Haning's Emporium]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Myri Antilles]], while working undercover inside the bar, noticed the musician behind his keyboard.<ref name="MK" />
